title: Recurrent processing is necessary for conscious seeing

statements.text: Recurrent processing between brain regions is necessary for conscious experience. Selectively disrupting it while leaving the feedforward sweep intact, by masking, by transcranial magnetic stimulation of V1, or by inactivating higher visual areas, prevents visual awareness.
statements.scope: Shown for vision, in monkeys and humans, by Lamme's group and by other laboratories.

sources.quote: show that recurrent or re-entrant processing between different regions of the brain is necessary for conscious experience
By selectively disrupting RP, but leaving FFS intact it is observed that visual awareness never arises.
